full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white candid street photograph compresses a crowded public gathering into one frame. Near the center, a dark-haired young adult woman in a dark coat and small dark hat turns her pale face toward a man standing close with his back partly to the camera. Her eyes are closed or lowered, and her lips part slightly as she leans toward him. The man's short dark hair and coat make a dark foreground shape that cuts across her shoulder. Around them, many other adults move in different directions. Hats, faces, jackets, and shoulders overlap so densely that no clear street or building can be seen. Several passing people are blurred by motion, especially along the upper left and lower edge, while the woman's face remains comparatively sharp and luminous. At right, a man in profile and a bald head in the lower foreground form secondary crisp shapes. Light is soft and diffuse, lifting faces to pale gray against dark coats. Strong black and white contrast is moderated by rich middle grays and fine film grain. The camera is at roughly head height, very close to the crowd, so the viewer seems to stand among the moving people. The central intimate gesture is not staged apart from the group; it is briefly visible through gaps between bodies. No readable signs or text appear. The composition is restless at its edges and still at its center, using blur, overlapping silhouettes, and a single quiet human exchange to capture an unrepeatable public moment. The photograph's emotional force comes from that small island of attention within anonymous flow.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白抓拍街头照片把拥挤公共聚会压入一个画框。中央附近一位深发年轻女子穿深色外套、戴小深帽，浅色脸转向一名靠得很近且部分背对镜头的男子。她双眼闭起或低垂，嘴微开，身体向他靠去。男子短深发和外套形成前景暗形，切过她肩部。周围许多成年人朝不同方向移动，帽、脸、夹克和肩密得重叠，看不到清楚街道或建筑。几位经过的人因运动而模糊，尤其左上与下缘；女子脸则相对清晰发亮。右边一名侧面男子与下前方秃头形成次要较清楚形。光柔和漫射，让脸在深外套前升成浅灰。强黑白对比由丰厚中灰和细胶片颗粒调和。镜头大致在人头高度，非常靠近人群，观者似乎站在移动人流里。中央亲近举动并未被安排到人群外，而是从身体间隙短暂显出。没有可读招牌或文字。构图边缘躁动、中央静止，借模糊、重叠剪影和一次安静人的交流捕捉不可重复的公共时刻。照片情绪力量来自匿名流动中这一小块注意力。
style_prompt_en: The candid mid-century monochrome photograph keeps one quiet focal interaction relatively sharp within a densely overlapping, motion-blurred crowd. Deep coats and hats create large black shapes; pale faces rise through rich middle gray and fine film grain. The camera sits at human eye level, close enough for bodies to crop one another and erase environmental clarity. Soft diffuse light avoids theatrical highlights. Passing figures smear at the margins, while a small central gap briefly becomes still. Composition is discovered rather than perfectly balanced, with profiles, backs, and shoulders entering unpredictably. The result is intimate and public at once, using authentic blur and layered silhouettes to convey fleeting human attention.
style_prompt_zh: 抓拍式中世纪现代单色照片让一处安静焦点交流在人群密集重叠与运动模糊中保持相对清楚。深外套与帽形成大黑形；浅脸从丰厚中灰和细胶片颗粒中浮出。镜头在人眼高度，近到身体互相裁切、抹去环境清晰度。柔和漫射光避免舞台亮斑。路过形体在画缘拖糊，中央小空隙短暂静下。构图像被发现而非完美安排，侧脸、背部与肩不可预测地进入。结果既亲近又公共，借真实模糊与叠层剪影传达短暂的人际关注。
theme_en: A dark-haired woman leans toward a man amid a blurred black-and-white city crowd
theme_zh: 黑白城市人群中，一位深发女子向男子靠近，周围行人模糊掠过
name: Alfred Eisenstaedt
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
